packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-20 -- unverified image reading (blind first reader)

No identification or prior reading of this record was in my context. I did nothing beyond the brief's rules (I listed the packet directory and checked image pixel sizes with sips to tell overviews from tiles).

LAYOUT SURVEY (face 1, overview image-001.jpg)
Observation: image-001 is a reduced overview of five separate paper(?) fragments laid on black, with a colour checker lower left and a cm scale at right. Each fragment carries a modern pencil shelfmark label "Stams, STA, Frg. 169-1r" ... "169-5r" (labels read: 169-5r upper left strip, 169-4r tall strip, 169-3r upper right sheet, 169-2r lower centre sheet, 169-1r lower right sheet). Two grey redaction boxes cover parts of 169-3r and 169-2r.
- 169-5r (narrow strip, upper left): almost blank; a couple of words in the upper half ("...ugga? ..." and below it a short word), torn right edge.
- 169-4r (tall strip): right-hand ends of c. 25 lines of a German cursive text (a letter? prose), left part lost; a pencil "1" at top.
- 169-3r (upper right, folded sheet with a vertical fold/crease ~ 3/4 across): German cursive notes/accounts in brown ink; upper block of c. 8 lines struck through with large X-crosses; modern pencil "1462 dec." added; then entries beginning "It(em)" with quantities ("XX metz ...", "XXV metz halb..."), i.e. a list/account in short entries. Right panel beyond the fold: c. 9 short lines beginning "It(em) hans ...".
- 169-2r (lower centre): heading at top left (word like "Abschrifft..."?), a word at top right; then c. 10 lines of a later (16th-c.-looking) German Kurrent cursive, unruled, single block; marginal word at right edge ("...").
- 169-1r (lower right): mostly blank paper with faint vertical notes (columns of short writing rotated 90°), and at lower right an address/notation block of several lines ("...", "Dem ...", "Walther ...", etc.), partly beyond the right edge.
Tentative interpretation: archival documentary fragments (accounts, letters/copies), not a literary codex; no columns, rubrics, initials or glosses as in a book hand.
Tile plan: tiles 002-017 = native-resolution 4x4 grid over this face (002-005 top row ... 014-017 bottom row).


=== image-004.jpg (tile: top row, 3rd column; left part of fragment 169-3r) ===
German cursive (Bastarda-like documentary hand), brown ink. Lines 1-8 struck through with large X-strokes (cancellation, text still legible). Right edge of tile cuts lines.
image-004 l.1: belaib(?) / und wey(?) er[?]esen(?) here(?) p[...]
image-004 l.2: weil ich im(?) zam(?) dz arm / mein g[...]
image-004 l.3: sol ich kain fur zog noch hewer(?) mo[...]
image-004 l.4: mich zu (superscr. o over u?) beyss(?) dz ich in angedin[...]
image-004 l.5: vn(d) weis er dir an prenst(?) / dz west[...]
image-004 l.6: flachs / od(er) (er-hook superscript) smaltz wie ich gen(?) dir a[...]
image-004 l.7: [?]h d(er)(?) fisch fur vil h(?) an samstag vor [...]
image-004 l.8: lech(?) ich im zo(?) dz(?) selben anno ix(?)lxij [...]   (pencil modern "1462" added to right below this line)
  left margin beside ll.7-8, enclosed in a drawn loop with a tie-line into the text: "dz / vissech(?) / ist" (an insertion?)
(gap; horizontal crease)
image-004 l.9: It(em) walthaur(?) vo(n) altdorff p(ra)cht(?) [...]   (single diagonal cancellation stroke across ll.9-11)
image-004 l.10: stag vor barb(?)[...] XX metz(en)(?) fesen(?) [...]
image-004 l.11: die(?) metze halb d(er)(?) grassh(?)[...] d(er)(?) p[...]

=== image-005.jpg (top row, 4th column; right part of 169-3r: line-ends of left panel + right panel beyond the fold) ===
Overlaps image-004 (same lines 1-11, continuing rightward). A strip of clear tape covers the fold area at upper centre.
Left panel, line ends (numbering matches image-004):
image-005 l.1: [...]n here(?) prengt(?) so
image-005 l.2: [...] / mein gelt(?) s[?]er(?)   (under tape)
image-005 l.3: [...] hewer(?) mon(?) gelt(?)

image-005 l.7: [...]stag vor lucie(?) do
image-005 l.8: [...]o ix(?)lxij in(?) [?]da(?) decembr(is)(?)
  pencil (modern): 1462 dec.
image-005 l.9: [...] pracht an dem-
image-005 l.10: [...]metz fesen(?) vnd
image-005 l.11: [...] d(er)(?) putt(?) zwo(?)
Right panel (separate column of entries, lighter partly-crossed X over middle lines):

image-005 r.2: It(em) hans dax(?)/k[?]y(?) vo(n) [...]
image-005 r.3: schoffl fesen [one word struck through heavily]
image-005 r.4: an seine(?) kirchen(?) a[...]

=== image-008.jpg (2nd row, 3rd column; lower left of 169-3r) ===
Top two lines overlap image-004 ll.10-11 (not new text). Then a gap, then a short list of four entries struck by one diagonal stroke. Grey redaction box at right covers area right of the last entries. Pencil label below: "Stams, STA, Frg. 169-3r" (last character read as r).
image-008 l.1 (= image-004 l.10): stag vor barb[...] XX metz[...] fesen[...]
image-008 l.2 (= image-004 l.11): die(?) metze halb d(er)(?) grassh(?)[...]
image-008 l.3: kunfft(?) / kumpt(?) d(er)(?) halb(?) (superscr. hook) XXVj metze halb[...]   (the XX has a scored underline/flourish)
image-008 l.4: gerst(en)(?) (superscr.) iiij metze
image-008 l.5: Gerste(?) / Roste(?) iij
image-008 l.6: fesen(?) vj metze
Rest of fragment below is blank (lower edge torn).

=== image-003.jpg (top row, 2nd column; upper half of strip 169-4r) ===
Pencil label at top: "Stams, STA, Frg. 169-4r". Later (16th/17th-c.-looking) German Kurrent cursive, grey-brown ink, unruled; the left side of every line is lost (strip cut/torn at left), so only line-ends survive. Grey offset/stain at upper right of strip.
image-003 l.1: [...]ige Regierung (o-superscript over u: Regierüng)
image-003 l.2: [...] E. G.(?) (= abbreviated title, e.g. "E(uer) G(naden)"?) schreib[en](?)
image-003 l.3: [...] auf dieselb(en)(?)
image-003 l.4: [...] betreffs(?) / betrifft(?), [following word struck through: "fetlo"?]
image-003 l.5: [...] (tiny "e" in margin at left) [...]j vnd h(?). Regiment(?),

image-003 l.7: [...] hat er auch zu

image-003 l.9: [...]d (cut at bottom of tile)

=== image-007.jpg (2nd row, 2nd column; lower half of strip 169-4r) ===
Top three lines overlap image-003 ll.6-8.
image-007 l.1 (= 003 l.6): [...]s die zu Lien[?]
image-007 l.2 (= 003 l.7): [...] hat er auch zu
image-007 l.3 (= 003 l.8): [...]ein wolten Ihre(?)
image-007 l.4: [...]d vermeinen(?) er
image-007 l.5: [...]halten thuet(?) (ü-mark over u), hab
image-007 l.6: [...]t mein(?) Darin(?) / Daran(?)
image-007 l.7: [...] E. G. wol zu
image-007 l.8: [...]fassen, dieweil

image-007 l.10: [...]ung (superscr. o/e over u) mügen(?) geb[en](?) (descender flourish)
image-007 l.11: [...] zu schreiben, weil(?) / wach(?)
image-007 l.12: [...]erinnern(?) an ob
image-007 l.13: [...]rgenkauffer(?) (u-mark) zu
image-007 l.14: [...]lich(?) kann(?) thil(?) [lower part cut by tile edge / tape at bottom]

=== image-010.jpg (3rd row, 2nd column; upper left of sheet 169-2r) ===
Top edge of tile shows bottom of strips 169-5r/169-4r (no text visible here). Sheet 169-2r: heading, then one block of 9 lines in a later German Kurrent cursive, faint grey-brown ink, unruled. Lines cut at the tile's right edge (continue in image-011). Faint offset/stains in left margin (no legible marginalia).
image-010 heading: Postscripta(?) (P with long descender; final -a)
image-010 l.1: E. G. wollen(?) im(?) mein Weber(?) d[...]
image-010 l.2: lassen außthüen(?) / außthun(?) ab Traunauf[...](?)
image-010 l.3: beim höcher(?) & Weg beim La[...]tstö[...](?)
image-010 l.4: derselb wendet(?) er sei von fest(?) [...]
image-010 l.5: E. G. wolle mich derhalben(?) ent[...]
image-010 l.6: dem Zimblen(?) von Aßerling(?) / Hairling(?) [...]

image-010 l.8: schlimeste(?) Wüerck(?) gemacht wär(?), w[...]
image-010 l.9: kenn(?) sehr geschwindig zuegeh[...]

=== image-011.jpg (3rd row, 3rd column; upper right of sheet 169-2r; bottom of strip 169-4r at top) ===
At top edge: the bottom line of strip 169-4r (= image-007 l.14, "[...]lich kann thil(?)"), no new text. Sheet 169-2r: right half of the 9-line block (continuations of image-010 lines), a word at top right, and a marginal note at far right partly under a transparent plastic holder/tape.
image-011 top right (heading-level, separate word): Diemüetig(?) / Demüetig(?) (large initial D with loop)
image-011 l.1: [...]ein Weber die Zins
image-011 l.2: [...]raünaustorff(?) (a short stroke through the ff-ending, deletion?) den(?)
image-011 l.3: [...]n Lattstötter(?) & dem(?)
image-011 l.4: [...] Von(?) fest(?) / selb(?) nicht schuldig
image-011 l.5: [...]halben(?) berichtet(?), den(?) Hanß(?) / fanz(?)
image-011 l.6: [...]ärling(?) Hr.(?) : Gmaint(?)
image-011 l.7: [...] göttes(?) dem(?) hauß(?) kein
image-011 l.8: [...] wär(?), wie ich(?) klar al
image-011 l.9: [...]ig zuegehet.
